name: Continuous Check for Events
hint: A loop that repeatedly checks a sensor or robot event lets the program react when the condition becomes true instead of checking only once.
instruction: Place the sensing condition inside a forever or until loop and put the appropriate response in its branch.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <@codeyB shaken ? :: sensing> then
say [Robot shaken]
end
end
